item.title: Vodka 4.0.0
item.description:
The first release under the Vodka name.

  • Statistics: total and recent playtime, most played, longest session and storage used (Vodka › Statistics…).
  • Settings in tabs, with new options: open at login, open Steam when Vodka opens, log retention and more.
  • Quitting stops everything running in your PCs, after asking first. Updates leave games running.
  • A new icon and accent color, and "Windows PC" is now just "PC".
  • No telemetry: usage tracking has been removed.
